Round 2 (from BASE_SHA; regression test committed first as badcae88, implementation as d3dacfd9): (1) NEW apps/mobile/src/data/installationKey.ts — one per-install id (makeUuid), kept ONLY in the device Keychain via react-native-keychain (service com.picklesensei.offline.installation-key, AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY, cloudSync:false, same pattern as the session vault), validated against ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$, write confirmed by read-back, 2s bound around each Keychain call, null on any failure/malformed/unconfirmed state, concurrent reads share one in-flight promise; never SQLite kv/AsyncStorage. (2) offlineCapabilities.ts: offlineGrantPullNeeded(wallet) — true only when pendingReceipts===0 and every grant is expired-by-trusted-time or an active identity_lifetime_free grant with remaining===0 (empty wallet ⇒ true; live grant, pending receipt, reconcile_required ⇒ false). (3) syncRuntime.ts: after a clean pass (outbox drained, no pending recovery/receipts), under an anchored trusted-time reading without rollback, for the configured generation and still-active owner, pullOfflineGrant reads the wallet, reads the installation key, registerDevice({installationKeyId, attestationEnvironment}) then requestOfflineGrant(requestedTickets = access.premium ? 0 : 2) which holds exactly what the server issued; owner/generation re-checked before and between the two calls. r1 A1 RESOLVED: the pull is gated on positive online evidence from THIS pass — every API client is wrapped (observingServerAnswers) so the runtime knows the LAST request was answered by the server; a pass started by a new canonicalAccess snapshot (useAccessStore.subscribe → trigger(true)) carries evidence; the backed-off retry of an HTTP-class transport failure (408/429/5xx/api-mapped 502) is allowed once per pass; an empty outbox draining cleanly, an anchored trusted-time reading, or a raw TypeError('Network request failed') is NOT signal — an offline device with an empty outbox never touches the network. r1 A3 RESOLVED: definitive refusals (ApiError 4xx except 401/408/429) are memoised process-wide in a Map keyed by owner → offlineGrantAccessKey(canonicalAccess) (premium/used/reserved/remaining/availableToReserve/entitlements) so clearSyncRuntime()+configureSyncRuntime() cycles under unchanged access do not re-request; a changed access snapshot or a held grant clears it. Transport failures bump consecutiveFailures (sync backoff); refusals are a healthy pass. Nothing spends, releases or reclaims. non_blocking_issues: INFERRED (read code, not run on device): the pull requires reading.authority === 'anchored' (syncRuntime.ts:249). Only api.ts authenticated round trips anchor trustedTime; the billing access check (src/billing/accessApi.ts) does not, so a pass started by the canonicalAccess subscription on a fresh launch with an empty outbox carries online evidence but no anchor and stays idle. In the shipping flow the first grant is therefore pulled by the sync pass that follows the first online analysis/shot sync (drainOutbox answered ⇒ anchored ⇒ pull), not at sign-in. Consistent with the objective's 'trusted-time reading available' precondition and with evaluateLease (a live grant can only be recognised under an anchored reading, so a weaker gate could request over a live grant); noted for the coordinator as product behaviour, not a defect.

INFERRED: a definitive 4xx from a request is classified as RequestEvidence 'none' (syncRuntime.ts:114-119); a pass whose only network work was rows the server rejected with 4xx ends without online evidence and does not pull that pass. Conservative direction (fails towards not requesting); next answered request pulls.
Refusal memo is in-memory per process (implementer-disclosed): a cold relaunch under unchanged access makes at most one register+issue pair before memoising again. Bounded, not a retry storm.
